objective: Reduce native Go RSS with simpler representation/ownership, preserving Java4.1 output and exact heatmap UI identities. RSS is primary; retain and report latency regressions.
reference_java_evidence: Existing immutable0.1.0 Java-paired29-case reports remain unchanged; old/new followup must not relabel them as candidate measurements.

deep-shared-cp.location_variation: each raw stack has distinct line/BCI; method names and IDs shared across chunks

protocol.first_fresh_process_pair: Retain separately and exclude from percentiles. File page-cache state uncontrolled.
protocol.order: Alternate old/new order each measured pair; case0 beginsold,case1 beginsnew, and so on. No concurrently timed processes.
protocol.rss: wait4 command high-water RSS, normalized to bytes; compute median,p95,max separately. Main values exclude harness and are not simultaneous tree sums.
protocol.latency: Whole fresh CLI subprocess including startup and output writing; p50 median, p95 nearest rank.
protocol.outputs: Remove each expected output before execution. Full collapsed stack/count maps and complete heatmap timeline/stack/count plus used ID/RGB/digest after every first,warmup,measured and separate tree pair, outside all timed intervals.
protocol.retention: Atomic raw JSON checkpoint after every command and verification, including failure metrics/status; no retries,outlier removal or changedN after observing results.
protocol.artifacts: Read-only baseline/candidate executable copies, existing trusted SHA input pool only; per-case aliases never link mutable originals. Do not duplicate large inputs.
protocol.isolation: Root grants exclusive CPU slot after all compilers,profilers and tests finish. Stop before insufficient disk headroom.
protocol.comparison: Ratios old/new:>1 means candidate faster; positive RSS reduction means lower candidate RSS. Publish all six cases, including unchanged/noisy/loss cells.
protocol.tree_RSS: Five extra RSS-only pairs for limited batch, excluded from timing percentiles; sample PID/PPID/RSS only; disclose shared-page double count and missed short-lived children.

optional_diagnostics_outside_timing.post_GC_batch: Use existing --memory-stats on an explicitly labeled64-input diagnostic for both versions, including heap_alloc,heap_inuse,go_retained,RSS,GCcount; forced-GC snapshots must never be merged into default latency measurements.
optional_diagnostics_outside_timing.heap_attribution: If needed, memory agent may use a separate temporary test driver under its package to profile Reader.NextChunk with chunk kept alive, plus convert allocation-space samples. No production profiling flags/server needed. Record instrumentation/build provenance; instrumented RSS/timing are diagnostic only.
optional_diagnostics_outside_timing.sampling: Inspect inuse_space/inuse_objects for liveCP and alloc_space/alloc_objects for temporary descriptions/IDs; these answer different questions. Profile before frozen N21 slot, never concurrently.

static_targets.CP_frames: 24B/frame baseline; proposed SoA13B normal /17B high-method-ID slabs preserve all64/32-bit values. The deep fixture has2.56M frames/chunk.
static_targets.conversion_scratch: Baseline resolvePath descriptions/IDs allocate per representative despite128-node merged profile; reusable caller-owned scratch may reduce transient traffic without a pool.
static_targets.heatmap: Remove unused mode-specific allocations; preserve exact method/stack rank and LZ frequency semantics. Do not reduce identity fidelity for RSS.
static_targets.small_floor: Startup around5MiB is a runtime/buffer floor; report absolute differences and avoid claiming a small noisy delta as structural gain.

acceptance: All output,public/semantic/UI and limit-cleanup checks remain green; demonstrate structural deepCP RSS reduction and report all six median/p95 RSS and latency changes. No tuned GC/runtime defaults without separately declared policy experiment.
source_provenance: The runner captures immutable binary hashes/build info and helper/oracle hashes. Root supplies and links the matching source/core manifest separately during packaging; the runner does not itself audit source provenance.
measurement_authorization: Root exclusive CPU GO after all functional/public/Linux gates completed; no other compiler/test/profiler tasks running.
